title: Trippy's Vanilla+
description: A collection of mods that enhance the vanilla Minecraft experience without adding anything not true to the base game.
body:
Trippy's Vanilla+ aims to enhance the vanilla experience through optimization, updated animations, and overhauled terrain generation while staying true to the spirit of vanilla Minecraft.

Inspired heavily by creators [demonjoeTV](https://www.youtube.com/@demonjoeTV) and [Incy](https://www.youtube.com/@incy000)
